purpose: Teach: 芋/熱帯/草原/銭湯/子犬/離島/自伝/自家製

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、田舎で芋掘り、毎年やった。
lines.en: When I was young, we dug for sweet potatoes every year out in the countryside.
lines.style: Soft opening, like memory itself is gentle. Quiet, measured pace. Pause after each phrase—letting each image settle. Voice trails slightly at the end, comfortable in the silence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。新婚旅行で、熱帯の島、行ったわね。
lines.en: Yes, we took that honeymoon trip to a tropical island.
lines.style: Agreement that holds affection. Warm acknowledgment. Gentle rhythm, no rush. The voice softens on 'tropical island'—a specific tenderness for that shared time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 草原を歩いた日、写真、残してる。
lines.en: I still have the photographs from those days walking through the grasslands.
lines.style: Quiet, deliberate. Weight on 'still have'—these images matter. Slower pace, almost meditative. Voice becomes more present as he speaks of the photos, like he's seeing them again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔は、銭湯、毎日のように行ってたわね。
lines.en: We used to go to the bathhouse almost every day back then.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia with a catch of longing. Softer volume. Pacing is unhurried, savoring the ordinary detail. Slight fade at the end—lingering on what those daily routines meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫が、子犬を欲しがってる、可愛いね。
lines.en: Our grandchild wants a puppy. It's sweet, really.
lines.style: Brightness enters the voice here. Lighter, almost affectionate. Genuine smile in the tone. Brief and direct, but the word 'sweet' carries real warmth—he's genuinely moved by the child's wish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 離島で、二人で過ごした夏、忘れない。
lines.en: That summer we spent together on the remote island—I'll never forget it.
lines.style: Deepest tenderness. Slower, more deliberate. Voice is steady but emotionally present. 'Never forget' lands with quiet certainty—not dramatic, but absolute. Slight breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、自伝を、書こうか、と思ってる。
lines.en: I've been thinking lately about writing down my life story.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative. Quieter conversational tone. Slight pause after 'lately'—he's been sitting with this idea. Voice carries mild wonder, no urgency, as if he's still deciding aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 自家製の梅干、毎年仕込んだわね。
lines.en: You made homemade plum preserves every year, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, almost teasing acknowledgment. Voice carries a small smile. Gentle, rhythmic—like a familiar ritual being named. Slight uplift at the very end, fondly confirming something they both know.
